race.title: Mongey Communications Novice Handicap Chase
race.verdict: MOYLUSSA arrives on the back of a solid Cork effort, form boosted by the winner since, and looks well treated on that evidence now back in handicap company, with Shellrunforbriggs feared most after an encouraging return from 5 months off at Galway last time and Latopix respected now switched to chasing for a yard that excels in this sphere. MOYLUSSA (IRE) SHELLRUNFORBRIGGS (IRE) LATOPIX (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Shellrunforbriggs (7/2), Giant Haystacks (4/1), Luimneach (5/1), Koori Star (7/1), Moylussa (7/1), Mywayofthinkin (8/1), Withabitofluk (8/1), Takenasred (12/1), Latopix (12/1)
